items.name: Brisket plate
items.description: Sliced brisket with sides at the tower smokehouse — barbecue in Texas, judged accordingly.
items.verdict: Good by theme-park standards, mid by state standards. Eat it for the calories and the AC, not the craft.

items.name: Fried chicken basket
items.description: Fried chicken with fries in the Spain section's air conditioning — the family lunch default.
items.verdict: Solid, hot, and served in the right building during the right hours.

items.name: Churro
items.description: Hot cinnamon-sugar churro from the Spain cart, eaten on a shaded bench between classic coasters.
items.verdict: The park's best walking snack by a mile — location does half the work.
